test.test_ctypes.reason: ctypes cannot hand a Python callback to C: a CFUNCTYPE instance carries no C-callable thunk, so ctypes.util.dllist's dl_iterate_phdr call fails. Also FAIL under PYRE_NO_JIT=1. test_dlerror wants dlsym returning NULL with a clear dlerror to raise

test.test_dataclasses.reason: JIT wrong code, not a platform difference: _process_class raises a spurious 'dictionary changed size during iteration' over cls.__dict__ although the only delattr completes before the loop. PYRE_NO_JIT=1 passes and darwin-arm64 passes, so it is neither the arch nor the OS alone

test.test_unittest.reason: GC bug, not a platform difference: invalid type_id at minor_custom_trace_target under minor_remembered_set, aborting through pyre_jit::call_jit::bh_call_fn mid-run. Passes when the driver is run directly, so it needs run.py's process shape to show up
